citation.title: Blood lactate response to a second bout of moderate-intensity aerobic exercise and to concurrent exercise

population.description: Forty-three men the paper calls healthy, in three studies of different people (study 1 n=20, study 2 n=11, study 3 n=12; 20+11+12=43); free of neurologic, cardiovascular or pulmonary disease, no medication, nonsmokers. Top-level age is study 1 (21 +/- 2 y); studies 2 (22 +/- 1) and 3 (21 +/- 2) override it. Height and weight are printed (study 1: 173 cm, 64 kg) but not BMI. VO2peak (ramp-incremental cycle test; Methods: 'In study 1, twenty participants (... VO2 peak 45.9 +/- 4.6 ml/kg/min; means +/- SDs)'). Study 2 (override): 'VO2 peak 47.0 +/- 4.3 ml/kg/min'; study 3 (override): 'VO2 peak 46.9 +/- 4.0 ml/kg/min'.

protocols.name: s1_two_bouts
protocols.description: Study 1: after a 12 h fast and at least 10 min seated rest (taken as 10 min, minutes 0-10; baseline sample after it), two 20-min bouts of cycling at an estimated 60% VO2peak (148 +/- 16 W) with a 20-min seated rest between: bout 1 minutes 10-30, rest 30-50, bout 2 minutes 50-70. Level: group VO2peak 45.9 mL/kg/min x 0.60 = 27.54 mL/kg/min, (27.54 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.752. Blood and HR taken at the end of each bout. Water only; no meal.

protocols.name: s2_re_rest
protocols.description: Study 2, RE trial (the ARCE visit's rest baseline is the same state and is not entered): 12 h fasted, seated rest at least 10 min (taken as 10 min), baseline sample at its end. The knee-extension bout after it is not entered (no whole-body VO2 printed), so the arm ends after the baseline sample.

protocols.name: s3_arce_miae
protocols.description: Study 3, ARCE trial (the RACE visit's rest baseline is the same state and is not entered): 12 h fasted, seated rest at least 10 min (taken as 10 min, baseline sample at its end), then a 20-min bout of cycling at an estimated 60% VO2peak (148 +/- 20 W), minutes 10-30; HR at the end of it. Level: group VO2peak 46.9 mL/kg/min x 0.60 = 28.14 mL/kg/min, (28.14 - 3.7) / 31.7 = 0.771. The knee-extension bout after a 20-min interval is not entered.
